description: This file defines a template class 'BaseContainerAdministrator' which manages a collection of container objects, providing methods for container retrieval, insertion, removal, and synchronization. It is part of the 'WPEFramework::ProcessContainers' namespace and includes external dependencies for process container management and iteration.

classes.name: BaseContainerAdministrator
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of container objects with thread-safe access, providing methods for container management and iteration.

methods.name: BaseContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the container list and lock.

methods.name: ~BaseContainerAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor that releases all active containers and logs if containers are still active during shutdown.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the container IDs, thread-safely.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, increasing its reference count if found.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container from the internal list, called when a container is destructed.

methods.name: InternalLock
methods.description: Locks the internal container list for thread-safe operations.

methods.name: InsertContainer
methods.description: Inserts a container into the internal list; must be called with the lock held.
